observation_source: Read-only exports from the stopped task-local platform and bridge stores after the runner preserved the immutable attempt.

root_cause.detail: create_app attempted to set formal_archive_intent_validator before constructing LocalLiliesBridge. The object was still null, so the production bridge retained no validator even though isolated coordinator and bridge tests passed.
root_cause.repair: Inject the current FormalRunArchiveCoordinator callback through the LocalLiliesBridge constructor and assert the production create_app wiring directly.

independent_review.scope: Production coordinator construction, constructor injection, callback binding, bridge-lock validation before reserve, and create_app regression.

claim_ceiling: This observation proves a production assembly defect and a failed customer attempt only. It does not prove host writeback, required artifacts, formal archive completion, independent oracle success, CAP-LILIES admission, or project pass.
